result.title: Tabular Foundation Models Are Effectively Shallow
result.summary: In-context-learning Tabular Foundation Models (TFMs) are uniquely suited to scenarios with limited resources or privacy constraints, as they solve new tasks without additional training. However, their architecture consists of multiple transformer blocks, resulting in high computational and memory footprints. Meanwhile, traditional alternatives like Gradient-Boosted Decision Trees (GBDTs) remain highly competitive and run efficiently on CPUs, suggesting that tabular tasks may not inherently require deep architectures. This contrast raises a fundamental question: can TFMs be simplified by removing architectural redundancies without sacrificing performance? To answer this, we introduce a closed-form, label-free affine translator that replaces a contiguous window of up to 96% of the blocks, leaving the rest unchanged. Evaluating eight frontier TFMs on 171 classification datasets, we reveal that tabular transformers are vastly overparameterized: replacing half of a model's blocks costs at most $0.002$ median AUROC across all architectures, with the half-depth TabFM still outperforming every other full-depth TFMs and tuned GBDTs. Furthermore, different model families are overparameterized in different ways: TabPFN-3 relies on its encoders, maintaining performance regardless of which single block is retained. Other single-axis models spread computation thinly, needing only their first block, while dual-axis models concentrate it in one critical block. Ultimately, removing depth saves up to 1.5B parameters, speeds up GPU inference by up to $6\times$ at a median cost of $0.03$ AUROC, while a single-block TabPFN-3 serves cached queries $2.4\times$ faster using $6\times$ less memory at negligible cost.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文研究表格基础模型是否真的需要深层结构，提出一种闭式、无需标签的仿射转换器替换连续 block 窗口（最多 96% 的 block），在 171 个分类数据集上评估 8 个前沿 TFM，发现半深度模型性能几乎不降，且不同模型族的冗余方式不同（有的依赖 encoder，有的集中在单个关键 block）。
AI.relevance_reason: 其逐 block 消融与关键层定位方法可供核查，可能启发 LVR 中 latent 状态对层深度/位置的依赖、以及推理期削减计算成本的分析；但研究对象为表格任务、无视觉模态，迁移线索属推测。
